notes: The server-side flight, parts, crystal healing, block destruction, damage and death are field-proven by csrc/tests/test_dragon.c (the DragonProbe state trace; DEVLOG reports 0 field mismatches for every end snapshot) and by the recordings end-arrival-s1 (portal, platform, a staged hit healed back), end-crystals-s1 (three crystals shot, each breaking the healing link), end-dragon-s1 (a real bow hit on the head, four staged hits, the 200-tick death, 3085 XP, the exit portal and the egg) and end-exit-s1 (exit portal, credits, respawn). The dragon is spawned by BiomeEndDecorator at chunk 0,0 (csrc/engine/populate_nether.c:populate_end_dragon, yaw from the decorate Random) and ticked in the End's entity pass (csrc/engine/serverreplay.c:sr_end_update calls dragon_tick). The client renderer side lives in csrc/engine/raster_mobs.c (dragon_draw and the 24 movement offsets). Not verified: nothing beyond what these notes state. Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): the client branch (interpolation, wing sound) is replaced by drawing server state. Formerly listed as missing: The client-side branch of onLivingUpdate (network position interpolation and the wing flap sound) has no native counterpart; the replay's client receives the dragon's already computed state instead. Since lane/endbot (2026-09-26): the client copy of the dragon exists natively (pickobj.c: the tracker entry, IAnimals range 80 and frequency 3, the S0F, moves, teleports and the health S1C; dragon.c:dragon_client_tick), so getMouseOver picks its parts and a melee C02 on a part lands (combat.c:combat_server_attack_part); knockBack and addVelocity set isAirBorne, which runs the entry's update block; the collision push with the player and with mobs lands in the entity query's chunk order; an unloaded dragon stays alive and frozen as the endermen's target while a reload is a new EntityDragon. GoldBot's End fight (endbot-s42, endbot-s1) exercises melee, bow, crystals, reloads and the exit. Since lane/endreturn (2026-09-27): the crystal heal clamps at the maximum as setHealth does (dragon.c: 199.5 heals to 200, end-tnt-s42 row 296); the seed-42 scenes from G29 cover the dragon tearing through a player's cobblestone and dirt pillar and a crystal tower's fire (end-pillar-s42), a TNT and a bed blast on its parts (end-tnt-s42, end-bed-s42), its unload with the player dead and away 1300 ticks and its reload as a new entity at the saved health (end-return-s42), and its death, exit portal and egg (end-egg-s42).
